description: Read memories saved for this signed-in learner: one per scope and kind.

kind.description: Return only this kind. Example: "study_preference". Omit to return every saved memory in the chosen scope.

project_id.description: UUID of the project, or null. Example: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111. Required when scope is project or both. Omit or null for learner-wide memories. Ignored when scope is global.

scope.description: Which memories to read: global (learner-wide), project (one project), or both. If omitted, the scope is both when project_id is a UUID, otherwise global.

name: read-memory

memories.description: Durable memory documents for the authenticated user.

projectId.description: Owning project UUID, or null for global memory.

updatedAt.description: Last time this memory document changed.

title: Read Studocu Agent Memory
